name: Evernote
author: Evernote Corporation
summary: Remember everything and tackle any project with your notes, tasks, and schedule all in one place.
description: Evernote helps you focus on what matters most and have access to your information when you need it. Input typed notes or scan handwritten notes. Add to-do’s, photos, images, web pages, or audio ... and it’s all instantly searchable. Organize notes any way you want and share with anyone. And Evernote syncs across your devices so your information is always with you, everywhere you go.

versions.release_notes:
✨ Features:
- Keep your table headers in view: freeze columns so they stay visible as you scroll horizontally.
- Reactions are here: select any text, pick an emoji from the inline toolbar, and everyone with access to the note can react.
- Meeting recordings started from notifications are saved in a note titled with the meeting's date and time, so you always know which call it was.

🛠️ Fixes:
- Templates: additional import fixes.
- After verifying your email via a shared notebook invite, you go directly to the notebook you were trying to open.
- Transcribing an image immediately after adding it no longer fails with a generic error.
- Hovering over the disabled transcript button on an audio recording now explains why there is no transcript and lets you enable automatic transcription.
- A table's horizontal scrollbar now appears only when the table overflows.
- On touchscreens, tabs and filter chips no longer remain highlighted after you tap them.

✨ Features:
- Tables get a new style menu: select non adjacent cells with Cmd/Ctrl, select the whole table with Cmd/Ctrl+A when a cell is focused, and align text in cells.
- Click an empty slot in the Day or Week view in Calendar to create a 30 minute event.
- The inline toolbar's More options menu now has a search field to find any formatting action.
- In note edits proposed by the AI Assistant are now clearer: choose to see only the original text, only the changed text, or both, with changes highlighted word by word instead of large red and green blocks.
- MCP can now read internal links, such as header links.

🛠️ Fixes:
- On Evernote Web, the browser tab now shows the open note's title.
- Completed reminders in the note list now appear greyed out.
- PDF, print, and HTML export now respect the strikethrough checklist setting.
- Dates now follow your relative dates setting as soon as the app starts.
- Fixes on Template imports and Meeting detection
- Transcription made more reliable

✨ Features:
- Following a recording is easier with the new audio player: a waveform for scrubbing, speaker avatars and pins, a playback speed selector, and editor controls that stay out of your way.
- Live transcripts are now saved on the note. When you replay a recording, the transcript appears alongside the audio in a resizable panel, so you can read and listen at the same time.
- Tasks in notes now show their priority and a description icon, like in the Tasks view.
- Your next audio summary uses the prompt you picked last instead of resetting to the default.
- Copy transcription is now in the audio player's overflow menu, under Transcription options.

🛠️ Fixes:
- AI title suggestions now also appear when you open a note in its own window.
- Shared notebooks now show their notebook name in the note list instead of only "Shared with me".
- Best Matches in search now honor advanced operators like tag and intitle.
- Exported .enex files with special characters (like "&") in image captions now import correctly.
- What's New articles now appear in your language, including Chinese.

✨ Features:
- You can now preview attached Markdown files as formatted text, and crop an image straight from the editor.
- You can now apply text color and highlighting to mentions in a note, including notes, notebooks, stacks, spaces, and people.
- Transcription recovery: if a transcription run fails, is interrupted, or the app closes mid run, Evernote now recovers the transcript saved on the backend.
- Opening a note now reconciles audio recordings left stuck in the capturing state, so a dead recording no longer leaves an empty placeholder behind.

🛠️ Fixes:
- Fixed a bug in which What's New articles appeared in English for some languages
- Live transcription no longer stops midway through a recording after you switch or connect an audio device.
- The AI Assistant and other AI features are now available in notes opened in a new window.
- Note titles in the Tasks list's Assigned note column are no longer cut off when there's room to display them.
- Folders you connect in Settings > Sync Folder now always appear in the list, so you can choose where their files go.
- Calendar colors now display correctly in the calendar picker when creating a new event.
- When inviting people to a Space, typing a name or email now filters the people who already have access, and the window closes when you click outside it.

✨ Features:
- Image and file annotation improvements: a Recent colors swatch that remembers your 8 most recently used custom colors, an Eyedropper tool to pick any color from the screen, text alignment, and some new animations and polished transitions.
- You can ask the AI Assistant to rename an attachment or recording, and review the change before it is applied.
- The calendar link suggestion after starting a recording now appears only for meeting recordings, skipping all day and multi day events.

🛠️ Fixes:
- A note is marked updated only when its content changes.
- The tab bar no longer gets cut off when you zoom the interface in or out.
- The in editor audio recorder bar no longer blocks clicks on the editor and tag menus.
- Pressing Enter or Tab after typing part of a tag name now reliably adds your existing tag instead of a new, shortened one.
- The Evernote logo is back in the Microsoft Store, Start menu, and taskbar on Windows.

✨ Features:
- Date mentions can now be formatted like the rest of the text.
- Improvements to speakers in transcription:
    - You can now see and assign speakers in the summary.
    - New buttons to move across speaker blocks.
    - A play button to start the audio from a specific speaker block.
    - Hover the "Speaker on" button to see the list of speakers.
- Redesigned the Move note modal.
- You can now drag multiple pages in the PDF editor.
- New connector with Meta Muse.

🛠️ Fixes:
- Note "updated": moving a note, or adding/removing tags, no longer updates the note timestamp.
- Fixed an issue where template import could fail.
- Made transcription more reliable.
- The Evernote icon in the macOS menu bar is now sharp on Retina displays.
- Notes opened in a separate window no longer open larger than your screen when moved between monitors with different display scaling.

✨ Features:
- When clicking on a note link in the app, you can now request access if you don't have it.
- Close tabs faster with two new options: Close other tabs and Close tabs to the right.
- You can now open an attachment in your computer's default app: Cmd+Click on Mac, Ctrl+Click on Windows.
- Tables are now much more powerful: sort and filter rows by column values, toggle a header row, customize borders, and distribute columns evenly (rolling out gradually).

- Fixed an issue where search with Include sub tags could omit notes tagged with the parent tag.

The Evernote you love, evolved. Use AI Assistant for smarter interactions with your notes, AI Meeting Notes for recordings with multi-speaker transcription, and a more powerful search that understands the meaning behind your words. Your second brain, leveled up.
